showFlagsTitle.text: Show flags in the language picker

showFlagsHelper.text: When enabled, each language shows a flag, display name, and BCP-47 tag. Flags stay hidden when only one language is available to operators.

availableHelper.text: Installed packs listed below. Disable a language to hide it from the operator picker. US English stays available for troubleshooting. Packs remain on disk when disabled.

loadError.text: Could not load language settings. Confirm you are signed in with permission to manage server settings.

intro.text: Controls idle and absolute timeouts for admin logon sessions. Changes apply to new sessions.

multiTabNote.text: Multiple tabs share the same logon session. Logoff in one tab ends all.
